d: Very long, flowing silver hair with long bangs and a side-swept fringe, tied in a high ponytail with a blue ribbon. Narrow, calm light-blue eyes on a youthful face with a mature expression. A slender build wearing a dark navy blue hooded jacket over a white collared shirt and a short pleated black skirt with white trim. Accessories include a tan tactical backpack with attached ammo pouches and gear, a black belt with a silver buckle, a black thigh strap with a pouch, white knee-high socks, and black lace-up shoes, while holding a black tactical rifle with a scope.
